title: Multiscale characterization of commercial and landfill-recovered plastics in Songkhla province, Thailand
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24424-24434
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03620H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nisamon Thongham, Parinya Khongprom, Chontira Sangsubun
Landfill-recovered PE from Songkhla, Thailland, was analyzed to assess its thermal, chemical, and morphological properties. Results support its potential for pyrolysis-based energy recovery from post-consumer plastic waste.
